This update makes starting and sleeping Omarchy feel a lot more finished, adds Korean, and moves the guest to Omarchy 4.0.4.

Omarchy's window now appears once the desktop is ready, instead of showing firmware text and black screens while it boots. The setup window stays up in the meantime with the starter keys, and Cancel shuts Omarchy down. The window also opens where you left it, stays put while Omarchy starts and shuts down, and starting Try Omarchy again brings the running window forward.

Omarchy now pauses before Windows sleeps and picks up where it left off when you wake the PC, including on laptops with Modern Standby.

The launcher is now available in Korean. Thanks to @seunghan91 for the translation. Every page of Settings can be translated now too, so Chinese and Korean will fill in as translations come in.

A few smaller fixes: Settings shows a realistic memory estimate when you open it while Omarchy is running, the window title always says Try Omarchy, a file you copied before starting Omarchy no longer shows an error if it's gone by the time Omarchy starts, and the importer says "1 file" instead of "1 files".

Inside the guest, Omarchy moves to 4.0.4. Existing installs get it through Update > Omarchy.
